rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition/Permanent Removal, or Capital Improvement Evictions
rules.quote: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.summary: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants evicted for owner move-in, demolition, permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant (max $24,733 per unit), plus $5,497 for elderly/disabled/minor children (3/1/26-2/28/27)
rules.exemption_note: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.citation: S.F. Rent Ordinance (Ellis Act relocation provisions)
rules.quote: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.summary: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants evicted under the Ellis Act.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant (max $33,330.13 per unit), plus $7,443.90 for elderly/disabled (3/1/26-2/28/27)
rules.exemption_note: Ellis Act evictions have higher relocation payment amounts and the additional payment applies to elderly tenants age 62 or older (rather than 60 or older).
